description: Portable file converter and viewer for images, documents, archives, fonts, CAD, 3D models, and geospatial formats.
notes: Uses the official Windows portable ZIP; the setup installer is not executed. This does not add Filee's Explorer menu, file associations, startup integration, or a system-wide PATH entry.

By default, settings are stored under %APPDATA%\Filee and downloaded optional conversion engines under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Filee\engines. These locations are outside the Scoop app directory and are not moved to D: automatically.
